goal: Play the first 10 minutes as a new player

findings.title: Season panel clipped at the right edge at 1280x720
findings.detail: The Season box's last word runs past the right edge of the screen.
findings.repro: pt.sh start --seed 42 (PT_WIDTH=1280 PT_HEIGHT=720); Start; Begin; shot

findings.title: Chronicle lines truncated with "..."
findings.detail: Long chronicle entries are cut off with an ellipsis and the compact strip offers no way to read the rest.

verdict: A clear first ten minutes: the objective tracker always says what to do next. Small layout problems at 1280x720.
